Oct 2026 • Friends
The food is fine, only the portions are a bit small. I had a great Alfredo pasta (which you find everywhere except in Italy). The only downside was the red wine, which was at refrigerator temperature. Excuse me, the reason was that the bottle was already opened in the morning and then goes bad quickly if you store it at room temperature. Special story.
